Autumn event at Hanno River on Saturday, October 31, 2026, 11:00 AM–7:00 PM at Hanno River Wooddeck Stage Plaza.

Food & Drink: Food trucks featuring Hanno area specialties including craft beer, curry, BBQ, yakitori (grilled chicken), and more.

Workshops: On-the-spot screen printing for T-shirts and hoodies.

Free Activities for Children:
• Bamboo boat workshop and racing
• Leaf pool treasure hunt
• Participants receive Halloween stickers and marshmallows as prizes

Evening Atmosphere: Sweden torches (tall log fires) create a magical nighttime ambiance. Music shifts from daytime nature sounds to dramatic evening and night selections as the sun sets.

Weather: Event will be cancelled in case of rain or severe weather. Cancellation notice will be posted on Instagram and X the day before.

Recommendation: Late October evenings get cold around sunset and after, so bring warm layers.

Organized by Okumushi Hanno Tourism Association.
summary: 📢 October 31 (Saturday): Autumn Hanno River Grilling & Beer Garden with Hanno Cuisine
